paragraphs.text:
Norman gives a short, shrill yelp. You only get a glimpse of 
the thing in the bushes: a giant ape—or ape-man. It must be a 
creature similar to the one that carried off Sylvia!

To follow the creature’s tracks, go to 362. To accept Sylvia is gone 
and  leave  the  lost  valley,  go  to  360. To  swallow  your  grief  for 
Sylvia, but keep exploring the area, go to 63.
